nodes.title: Human capability
nodes.summary: The complete human--AI capability system keeps purpose, evidence, authority, action, and learning in one inspectable composition.
nodes.result: Capability compounds without erasing its human owner.
nodes.human: Purpose, judgment, responsibility, and the right to contest.
nodes.ai: Retrieval, synthesis, simulation, and bounded execution.
nodes.guard: A named purpose, accountable human owner, and retained right to stop exist for every composed stage.

nodes.title: Human capability cycle
nodes.summary: Knowledge becomes qualified action, and every outcome returns to strengthen the next cycle.
nodes.result: The lifecycle closes through returned evidence.
nodes.human: Own the purpose of the cycle and judge whether it remains legitimate.
nodes.ai: Carry bounded work across the composed cases.
nodes.guard: Knowledge, qualification, and outcome receipts are all present before the lifecycle may close.

nodes.title: Knowledge interface
nodes.summary: Access, understanding, and composition turn abundant information into usable human context.
nodes.result: Information becomes agency rather than passive consumption.
nodes.human: Frame the question, supply context, and challenge meaning.
nodes.ai: Discover, retrieve, connect, and expose relevant material.
nodes.guard: The question, source scope, and challenge path are explicit before material becomes working context.

nodes.title: Reach consequential knowledge
nodes.summary: Open paths to records, code, models, and hard-won human experience without requiring privileged institutional access.
nodes.human: Choose what matters and whose knowledge must remain visible.
nodes.ai: Discover, retrieve, and attribute relevant sources.
nodes.guard: The request has a declared purpose and every returned source carries provenance and attribution.

nodes.title: See meaning and limits
nodes.summary: Keep sources, context, uncertainty, disagreement, and semantic definitions visible enough to inspect and challenge.
nodes.human: Interpret significance, uncertainty, and lived context.
nodes.ai: Contextualize evidence and expose competing explanations.
nodes.guard: Sources, uncertainty, disagreement, and semantic limits are attached to the interpretation.

nodes.title: Build new working context
nodes.summary: Connect knowledge, software, scientific models, and human judgment so isolated fragments become usable capability.
nodes.human: Frame the synthesis and preserve the purpose behind it.
nodes.ai: Connect records, code, models, and candidate structures.
nodes.guard: At least two compatible artifacts are connected to a stated human purpose and reviewable context.

nodes.title: Governed action
nodes.summary: Qualification separates what a system can do from what accountable people and institutions permit it to do.
nodes.human: Retain accountable authority at consequential transitions.
nodes.ai: Execute only the admitted and inspectable operation.
nodes.guard: A bounded operation has evidence, policy constraints, a responsible authority, and a stop path.

nodes.title: Determine what may proceed
nodes.summary: Separate possible output from the action that evidence, policy, proof, and responsible authority actually permit.
nodes.human: Judge adequacy, responsibility, and acceptable risk.
nodes.ai: Verify constraints, evidence, and formal obligations.
nodes.guard: Verification, applicable policy, proof obligations, and named accountable authority all admit the action.

nodes.title: Move without surrendering agency
nodes.summary: Let people apply judgment, accept responsibility, contest decisions, and retain the right to pause or stop consequential action.
nodes.human: Decide, execute, pause, appeal, or stop.
nodes.ai: Perform the bounded action and preserve an operational receipt.
nodes.guard: The admitted plan remains within authority scope and preserves pause, appeal, rollback, and stop controls.

nodes.title: Evidence return
nodes.summary: Outcomes, failures, corrections, and local experience return as shared material for inspection and reuse.
nodes.human: Interpret the outcome and decide what should change next.
nodes.ai: Record, index, and reconnect receipts to their sources.
nodes.guard: An outcome, failure, or correction is attributable to its action and available for inspection.

nodes.title: Return outcomes as shared evidence
nodes.summary: Turn results, failures, corrections, and local experience into inspectable evidence that strengthens the next person and institution.
nodes.human: Correct meaning, share experience, and choose the next question.
nodes.ai: Record, retrieve, and reuse qualified outcomes.
nodes.guard: The returned receipt is attributable, contestable, reusable, and linked to the next question.

pressure.info: Choose the pressure that should test this principle.

entries.useIf: confidence is advancing faster than provenance, verification, or reproducibility
automation is approaching a decision where people retain benefit, responsibility, or the right to stop
rapid technical change could marginalize students, practitioners, or communities instead of increasing their agency

entries.full: Open foundations and real exit rights
entries.useIf: dependency could become opaque control, lock-in, or extraction from the wider community
short-term growth could weaken foundational technology, trusted operation, or ecosystem reinvestment
